description: This file defines a JavaScript module providing functions to fetch and filter recipe data, notably the getRecipes function. It includes logic for filtering recipes based on search terms, sorting, and predefined filters. The module supports switching between mock data and a real API endpoint.

methods.name: applyFilters(items, { q, sort, filters })
methods.description: Applies client-side filtering and sorting to a list of recipe items based on search query, filters, and sort options.

methods.name: getRecipes({ q = '', sort = 'relevance', filters = {} } = {})
methods.description: Returns recipes, optionally filtered and sorted, with support to switch between mock data and real API (the latter currently commented out).

ctags.name: getRecipes
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getRecipes({ q = '', sort = 'relevance', filters = {} } = {}) {$/
